chunks: And it was also narrated from Ibn 'Abbas that he said:

All of these reports have indeed been narrated by those who oppose us, and that which our companions have uniquely transmitted is more than can be counted; and I shall mention a portion of that, if Allah wills.
Among that is: Jibra'il عليه السلام brought it down with this.

key_terms.أَصْحَابُنَا: Our companions; the followers and transmitters associated with the Shia tradition.
key_terms.الْأَخْبَارِ: Narrations or reports transmitted on the issue.
key_terms.جَبْرَئِيلُ: Jibra'il عليه السلام, the angel who brought down divine instruction.
key_terms.غَسْلَتَانِ: Two washings in the description of wudu (ablution).
key_terms.مَسْحَتَانِ: Two wipings in the description of wudu (ablution).
key_terms.مُخَالِفُونَا: Those who oppose us; i.e., transmitters outside the Imamiyyah position.

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about the prescribed form of wudu (ablution)?
ai.summary: This report concerns the prescribed form of wudu (ablution), expressing it as two washings and two wipings. It also emphasizes that reports supporting this understanding were transmitted broadly, including by opponents, while the transmissions of the companions are even more numerous.
